== Summary ==
Identified: [[Jack Douglass]] (left, hair in a bun, glasses, a beard, and a black sunset-graphic tee; same face as his named 2025 Worlds photographs) and [[Nathan Davis]] (right, blue Seattle cap and a black Star Wars tee; same face and cap as [[:File:Nathan Davis 2025 World Championship.jpg]]). The smiling player in a navy "TEACHER BY DAY" tee holds a JUSTIN M / joyjoy 2021 Advocate Award card whose portrait is the grey-hoodie player in the background (also [[:File:2025 Oregon State Championship 3.jpg]]). Remaining faces unlabeled.

The 2025 Oregon State Championship in a private basement in Portland (21 June 2025).

The smiling player in a navy "TEACHER BY DAY" tee holds a JUSTIN M / joyjoy 2021 Advocate Award card whose portrait is the grey-hoodie player in the background (also [[:File:2025 Oregon State Championship 3.jpg]]). Remaining faces unlabeled.
